name: ad_dc_overview
description: AD 服务器概览 counters (users / groups / gpos) + partner_port_status. One row per DC, upserted on (dc_name). Cadence independent of replication cycle so overview stays fresh even when replication is broken. Data lands in public ad_dc_overview table via a centre-side post-hook (see center/src/packages/runner.js); this manifest has NO `database` block by design (R110.A architectural pivot: 公共表, not pkg_* schema).
